sections.skill: Justify that the inscribed hexagon is regular

branch.new_demand: Prove that the construction yields a regular hexagon.

questions.skill: Justify that the inscribed hexagon is regular
questions.standard_level: Geometry. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Geometry, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.response: write the answer and show the required work
questions.prompt: Six points are marked around a circle with center O by stepping the radius. Prove that the hexagon they form is regular.
questions.prompt_markup: Six points are marked around a circle with center O by stepping the radius. Prove that the hexagon they form is regular.
questions.required_method: Show the six triangles from O are equilateral (all sides r), so all sides equal r and all angles equal 120°.
questions.grading_note: Any valid proof. Essential: each triangle O-consecutive points has three sides equal to r (equilateral, 60° at O); six 60° angles fill 360°, so the stepping closes; all sides equal r; each hexagon angle is 60° + 60° = 120°.
